description: Original principles-inspired residence for a 75.1 sqm Shanghai apartment, not an actual hotel depiction or replica.

inspiration_sources.role: Official design principles supplied and verified by parent: minimal geometry, ryokan references, framing nature; not an image input.
Official gallery inspiration URL supplied by parent; not an image input.

validation.inspection: Each input inspected before generation, each final output visually reviewed against target geometry.
validation.notes: All room geometry and principal functional placements visibly preserved. Small generated-detail changes and finish deviations are documented per image.

images.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: full-frame photorealistic interior design visualization for one 75.1 square metre Shanghai two-bedroom apartment. Concept: 石庭隐居, an ORIGINAL residence guided by quiet geometric discipline, refined ryokan-inspired craft and framed nature; not a depiction, replica, product claim or branded image of any hotel.
INPUT ROLE: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and absolute GEOMETRY/CAMERA reference. Preserve its exact living/dining room footprint, camera position, perspective, lens field of view, ceiling height and rectangular tray/beam geometry, all wall extents, all openings, left glass partition and structural pier, rear right doorway, TV on left, sofa on right, dining at rear. Keep the combined living/dining area plausible at 21.4 sqm; do not expand. Transform finishes, furnishing design and light quality only.
DESIGN: Make a new coherent restrained luxury interior. Warm ivory mineral-plaster walls contrasted with long horizontal smoked-oak wall panels and a few precise charcoal timber screen lines. Grey-greige honed limestone floor with subtle real stone grain, matte not glossy marble. Keep original ceiling form but replace fixtures with a quiet low-profile warm diffused washi-like flush lantern and one small dining pendant. 3000 K illumination, balanced with directional late-afternoon light from the same left direction; believable contact shadows, calm brighter natural exposure, detailed surfaces.
Right sofa: slim low premium design, warm taupe nubuck or fine smooth linen upholstery, thin dark timber base, restrained cushions, lightly warm tan leather accent. Absolutely no blue, no chunky bulbous sofa. Centre coffee table: slender low dark smoked-oak rounded rectangular table, rich fine grain and expertly softened edges. Large ivory finely hand-knotted wool/silk rug, smooth short pile with delicate variation, NO coarse jute, sisal, shag or heavy chunky texture. Left TV console: slim long low dark-oak piece with small balanced stone/ceramic objects. Dining furniture in rear: compact slim smoked-oak rectangular table with gently rounded edges, four fine tan-leather chairs, slim sideboard at rear right. Retain the narrow bookshelf beside the left pier, change to fine smoked-oak craft. The rear dining wall should have one quiet vertically oriented ink/stone-tone art panel on warm mineral plaster above a dark horizontal timber band; only this one art panel in living/dining. The wall behind sofa should be softly textured mineral plaster with restrained dark horizontal joinery, no extra artwork. One carefully arranged branch in an artisan vase, sparse books and a shallow stone bowl. Rich tactile handcraft, furnished and comfortable, no generic all-beige wash.
INVARIANTS: identical camera and layout, keep existing structural beam and window/partition wall, keep the enclosed urban Shanghai apartment setting. Do not open a kitchen wall, add openings, invent a courtyard, forest, mountains, villa, extra space or extra furniture zones.
OUTPUT: one clean complete image only, native landscape 3:2 framing, original photographic texture and fine detail, realistic reflections and shadows. No collage, before-after, graphic layout, text, labels, logo, watermark, human figures or artificial upscaling.

input_images.role: edit target; absolute geometry and camera

images.visual_review: Camera, structural pier, left glass partition, rear dining location, doorway, ceiling tray and beams preserved. Sofa remains right, TV left. Fine soft ivory rug reads somewhat more visibly textured than requested; low rounded timber table retains a relatively solid block form.

A restrained branch in a dark handmade vase on table and shallow ceramic bowl. Keep living-reference material colors and craft; no additional artwork, no large new decorative element.
